fieldValues.title: Layers: SRS implementation
fieldValues.article_text: Layers that stay apart: srs-core (no I/O), then srs-repository (all logic), then adapters (CLI, bindings, mcp-core, mcp), then clients. Rule: semantics live once, in srs-repository. ADR-048 rule 6 (identifier over label) specialises the Identity cell.
